# Calorie
> A private, local-first iPhone and iPad journal for food, four core nutrients, water, weight, routines, and transparent timing guidance. Optional Apple sign-in can add private Cloudflare sync.

## When to use this
- Best fit: Understanding Calorie as a private native food and body journal
- Best fit: Checking how food timestamps and personal targets produce transparent fasting, exercise, and sleep estimates
- Best fit: Confirming current access, privacy, TestFlight, and non-medical boundaries
- Not a fit: Medical, nutrition, or weight-loss prescriptions
- Not a fit: Barcode scanning, social feeds, wearable sync, or workout programming
- Not a fit: Public App Store or TestFlight installation links

## Product boundaries
- No social feed
- Not medical advice
- Default data is local-first; optional private cloud sync
- No App Store listing yet
